Ex-Sailor and Restaurant Owner

CR 2

XP 600
Male human expert 4
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+3 armor, -1 Dex)
hp 22 (4d8+4)
Fort +3, Ref +0, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork dagger +3 (1d4/19-20)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 8, Con 11, Int 11, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +3; CMB +3; CMD 12
Feats Alertness, Great Fortitude, Skill Focus (Profession [sailor])
Skills Climb +7, Knowledge (geography) +7, Perception +11, Profession (innkeeper) +9, Profession (sailor) +12, Sense Motive +11, Swim +7
Languages Common
NPC Gear masterwork dagger, masterwork studded leather armor, spyglass
